name: MOST SNAKES EVER - Tum Mere Ho Review
description:
We had the privilege of reviewing Tum Mere Ho, one of Aamir Khan's earliest and snakiest performances. This is movie explores some adult themes, the only childish thing about it is all the marriage.

Tell us what you thought (nicely).
